rules.rationale: AP-1 baseline (#308 story E): a classified read-only MCP tool is allowed. Marker-only on purpose: no target, so a shell redirect into mcp/ cannot match (loader check V4), and a shell verb token equal to the marker is unresolved (PT-1). The verb-only shell read allow rests on story E0 (#408): the shell normalizer resolves only the closed read-only set (ls, cat, head, tail, wc, grep) to a read, so the allow covers nothing else (shell verb resolution is tool-blind, PT-2).
